title: Fix: deleted files still appear in cache after deletion
body: invalidate_all_caches() in dashboard.rs only clears dir_cache_* keys. The global all_files_index / all_files_index_{branch} cache is not cleared on deletion, so deleted files can reappear. Fix: extend the key-scan loop in invalidate_all_caches() to also remove keys starting with 'all_files_index'. See PLANNING.md Phase 22.
